title: Mootcombe's Long Table 'weigh' text lists the bargain ending's requirement as 'three refused, in Mootcombe: the levy-reeve's warrant, the victualler's contract, and the cooper's timber.' I had already succeeded at two of these (Osric's warrant, Fulk's contract) for an unrelated reason (protecting the future commons vote) before ever reading this text — so I had unknowingly banked 2 of 3 requirements toward an ending I wasn't pursuing, with no indicator at the time each was earned that it counted toward anything beyond the immediate NPC interaction.
